acquisition_method.evidence: The instrument method for the LTQ Orbitrap was set up in data dependent mode to switch consistently between MS and MS/MS.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: A volume corresponding to 50 µg for each depleted sample was reduced by TCEP 50 mM (60 min, 60°C), alkylated by iodoacetamide 84 mM (30 min, RT) and digested overnight by adding trypsin (Promega).

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptide fractionation and Mass Spectrometry Isoelectric point (pI) fractionation was done with the Agilent 3100 OFFGEL fractionator (Agilent Technologies).
